description: Her size at one brand, in that brand's own labels (for example 32E at a UK-lettered brand where her US size is 32DDD), for its band and cup bras and for its letter-sized styles, each with a confidence badge and a reason. Use this when a shopper names a brand. If the brand doesn't carry her size, the answer says so and why (for example its bands start at 34); pass that on rather than guessing. Use list_bra_brands if the brand isn't found.

brand.description: A brand name as shoppers write it (aliases accepted, any case), or an id from the brand list.

bust.description: Around the fullest part of the bust, the tape flat and not pressing in. Decimals allowed.

underbust.description: Snug around the ribcage, just under the bust, after breathing out. Decimals allowed.

unit.description: The unit both measurements are in: inches (in) or centimetres (cm).

name: bra_size_at_brand
title: Bra size at a brand
